title: Log in and fix it
briefing: web-01 is paged: the site returns 502 Bad Gateway. From ops-01 you can see
it (curl -I http://web-01/), but to fix it you have to get ONTO it.
Log in over ssh as admin and bring the web server back up. Once you ssh in,
every command runs on web-01 — the same tools you already know.
tips: `ssh admin@web-01` logs you in; your prompt changes to admin@web-01.
There, treat it like any box: check the service and start it. `exit` returns to ops-01.
objective: SSH into web-01 as admin and start its nginx service so the site is back up (nginx active on web-01).
expert_objective: web-01 returns 502. Log in and restore nginx.
hints: Get on the box: `ssh admin@web-01`. Then look: `systemctl status nginx` shows it's inactive (dead).
Start it (admin has sudo there): `sudo systemctl start nginx`.
`ssh admin@web-01`, then `sudo systemctl start nginx`. `systemctl is-active nginx` prints 'active'.
solution:
ssh admin@web-01
systemctl status nginx
sudo systemctl start nginx
explanation: This is remote administration in a nutshell: ssh puts you on the far machine, and from there it's the same Linux you know. You diagnosed a down service and started it — on a server you never physically touch. `exit` closes the connection and brings you home.
